fieldValues.title: One routine per seat, serving every group in turn
fieldValues.move: Replace the per-group routines with one routine per seat (builder, reviewer, steward, analyst) whose brief reads clerk groups --json and serves each chartered group in turn, by the group's room and its own order, as the bug fixer's brief already does for the builder seat (clerk#151). Each standing job has one standing-job record, and clerk routines --check runs on a schedule and reports a lost or drifted trigger on the desk.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not raise the platform's limit on routines, and a single routine is a single point of failure for every group; it does not decide each group's order (remedy 9938939f does).
fieldValues.falsifier: After two cycles, a group with room and ready work still goes a cycle without a build, or the trigger count has not fallen.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-27: vignette 0601eb2e (the working group setup is heavy; we keep losing routines)
